detailed_description: The CSS Flexbox Generator creates a small browser-side flexbox preview and CSS snippet from form controls. You can choose flex-direction, justify-content, align-items, flex-wrap, a pixel gap value, and an item count from 1 to 12. The preview shows numbered placeholder items, the generated CSS includes a `.flex-container` block and a simple `.flex-item` placeholder, and the CSS can be copied. The tool includes a short quick reference, but it does not add or remove custom item content, control margins or item order, generate vendor prefixes, inspect computed styles, visualize nested flex layouts, provide percentage sizing controls, or show visual guide overlays.
usage_steps: Choose the flex direction, justify-content, align-items, and flex-wrap values.
Set how many placeholder items to show, from 1 to 12.
Review the browser-side preview and generated CSS snippet.
Copy the CSS when the simple layout settings look useful.
usage_examples: Preview a row layout with centered items before copying the CSS.
Test wrap behavior with several placeholder items and a fixed pixel gap.
Compare different justify-content values for a simple container.
Copy a starter `.flex-container` snippet for manual editing in your project.
